variant.label: Ours, smoothed f
variant.summary: A second function on the same points: f averaged over its neighbours 3 times.

traits.function: f averaged with its kNN neighbours, 3 times (a second, smoother function)
traits.ties: broken by vertex index (a strict total order)
traits.saddles: AnyEG's: vertices whose higher neighbours fall into two or more separate groups; only the highest one per pair of maxima
traits.links: a saddle joins the maxima its higher neighbours climb to (two per link)
traits.loops: a loop-closing saddle is kept only if the valley below it runs deep (relief >= 0.5)
traits.simplification: persistence: the noise slider (p_lo) merges small peaks, p_hi cuts deep links
